card.name: BR split inside words
card.fires_on: The letters BR or Br (also br after a hyphen or dot) when they begin a word that was split, as in BRADSHAW, BRCA, BRIVIACT, BRONCHOSPASTIC, brain.

modes.label: Capital BR in split names
modes.description: Upper-case BR starting a drug, gene or heading word that continues in the next piece.

modes.label: Lowercase br after a symbol
modes.description: br after a hyphen or dot that begins a word like brain or brilliant.

card.writes: Little clear effect; it weakly favors continuations that finish odd word beginnings.
card.plain: It fires when a word starting with BR has been broken apart, such as BRCA or BRONCHOSPASTIC.
